name: OpsBase
tagline: Build a business that runs without you.
description: OpsBase is the operations management platform for small business owners who are trapped running every aspect of their business. It combines SOP documentation, task delegation, workflow automation, and team coordination into one hub — so your business keeps running whether you're there or not.
pain_point: Small business owners cannot step away from their business because operations, decisions, and client communication all depend on them personally.
target_audience: Small business owners (5-50 employees) in service industries — trades, medical practices, agencies, restaurants, salons, repair shops — who want to systematize operations and reduce owner-dependency.
competitive_gaps: No existing tool is designed specifically for owner-independence — all are generic project/process tools
Most competitors only handle documentation OR task management, never both together with delegation logic
No competitor offers an owner-absence mode with automated handoffs and escalation rules
Decision delegation with spending limits and authority levels doesn't exist in current tools
Per-seat pricing makes competitors prohibitively expensive for 10-30 person teams

features.name: SOP Builder
features.description: Create, version, and organize standard operating procedures with step-by-step instructions, checklists, embedded media, and role assignments. Staff can mark steps complete and flag issues.
acceptance_criteria: Users can create multi-step SOPs with rich text, images, and video embeds
SOPs support versioning with change history and rollback
SOPs can be assigned to specific roles or team members
Staff can execute SOPs as interactive checklists and mark steps complete

features.name: Task Delegation Engine
features.description: Create, assign, and track tasks with due dates, priority levels, dependencies, and automatic escalation rules when tasks are overdue or blocked.
acceptance_criteria: Tasks can be created with title, description, assignee, due date, and priority
Tasks support dependencies so blocked tasks are clearly visible
Overdue tasks automatically escalate to the next person in the escalation chain
Assignees receive notifications on assignment, reminders before due dates, and escalation alerts

features.name: Team Workspace & Dashboard
features.description: Centralized workspace showing real-time business status — open tasks, active workflows, pending decisions, and team availability at a glance.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard displays summary cards for tasks, workflows, escalations, and team status
Each team member has a personalized view showing their assignments and priorities
Real-time updates without page refresh using WebSocket or polling
Workspace supports multiple business locations or departments

features.name: Role & Permission Management
features.description: Define custom roles with granular permissions controlling access to SOPs, tasks, clients, financials, and admin settings. Supports role hierarchy for escalation.
acceptance_criteria: Admins can create custom roles with granular permission toggles per feature area
Roles support hierarchy levels for escalation chain routing
Users can be assigned multiple roles
Permission changes take effect immediately across all sessions

features.name: Workflow Automation Engine
features.description: Visual builder to define automated workflows triggered by events (new client, task completion, schedule change) with conditions, actions, and notifications.
acceptance_criteria: Users can create workflows with triggers, conditions, and actions via a visual drag-and-drop builder
Supports event triggers: task completion, form submission, schedule change, time-based
Actions include: create task, send notification, update record, assign to role
Workflow execution history is logged with success/failure status

features.name: Decision Delegation Framework
features.description: Pre-authorize team members to make specific categories of decisions with defined spending limits, authority levels, and approval workflows for edge cases.
acceptance_criteria: Owners can define decision categories (purchasing, refunds, scheduling changes, client issues)
Each category has assignable authority levels with monetary thresholds
Decisions within authority are auto-approved; out-of-scope decisions trigger approval requests
Full audit trail of all decisions made, by whom, and under what authority

features.name: Client Communication Hub
features.description: Centralized inbox aggregating client emails, messages, and notes. Supports auto-responses, templates, and assignment so any team member can handle client requests.
acceptance_criteria: Incoming client communications appear in a shared team inbox
Messages can be assigned to specific team members with internal notes
Template responses can be created and used for common inquiries
Auto-responses can be configured for after-hours or owner-absence periods

features.name: Shift & Staff Scheduling
features.description: Create and manage staff schedules with shift templates, availability tracking, swap requests, and automatic conflict detection.
acceptance_criteria: Managers can create weekly/monthly schedules with drag-and-drop shifts
Staff can set recurring availability and request time off
Shift swap requests can be submitted and approved by designated managers
Schedule conflicts and understaffing warnings are flagged automatically

features.name: Owner Absence Mode
features.description: Activate a special mode when the owner steps away that routes all escalations to designated delegates, enables auto-responses, and logs everything for the owner's return.
acceptance_criteria: Owner can activate absence mode with start/end dates and designated delegates
All escalations that would normally reach the owner are rerouted to delegates
Auto-response messages activate for client-facing communications
A comprehensive absence report is generated when the owner returns

features.name: Knowledge Base
features.description: Searchable repository of business knowledge — procedures, FAQs, vendor contacts, equipment manuals, policies — accessible to all team members by role.
acceptance_criteria: Articles can be created with rich text, file attachments, and categories
Full-text search across all knowledge base content
Access can be restricted by role so sensitive information is protected
Articles track view counts and last-updated dates for maintenance

features.name: Activity Feed & Audit Log
features.description: Chronological feed of all business activities — task completions, decisions made, SOPs executed, schedule changes — with filtering by team member, category, and date.
acceptance_criteria: All significant actions are logged with timestamp, actor, and details
Feed supports filtering by user, action type, date range, and entity
Entries link to the relevant task, SOP, or decision for context
Feed is exportable as CSV for compliance or review purposes

features.name: Team Chat & Announcements
features.description: Internal messaging with channels for departments/topics, direct messages, and a pinned announcements board for company-wide updates.
acceptance_criteria: Users can create topic-based channels and send direct messages
Announcements can be pinned and marked as required-read with acknowledgment tracking
Messages support @mentions that trigger notifications
Chat history is searchable and persistent

features.name: Vendor & Supplier Management
features.description: Track vendor contacts, contracts, order history, and reorder points. Set up automated purchase order workflows with approval thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Vendor profiles store contact info, contracts, payment terms, and notes
Order history is tracked with dates, amounts, and delivery status
Reorder point alerts notify the assigned purchaser when inventory is low
Purchase orders above threshold amounts trigger approval workflows

features.name: Operations Dashboard & Analytics
features.description: Real-time dashboards showing task completion rates, SOP adherence, response times, bottlenecks, and team performance trends over time.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows KPIs: open tasks, overdue items, SOP completion rate, avg response time
Charts display trends over configurable time periods (7d, 30d, 90d)
Bottleneck detection highlights repeatedly delayed tasks or overburdened team members
Dashboard data is exportable as PDF or CSV

features.name: Owner Absence Report
features.description: Auto-generated summary of everything that happened while the owner was away — decisions made, tasks completed, issues escalated, clients contacted, money spent.
acceptance_criteria: Report auto-generates when owner deactivates absence mode
Includes categorized summary: decisions, tasks, escalations, financials, client interactions
Flagged items that need owner review are highlighted at the top
Report is saved in history and can be exported as PDF

features.name: Custom Fields & Templates
features.description: Extend tasks, SOPs, clients, and vendors with custom fields (text, number, date, dropdown). Create templates for frequently used configurations.
acceptance_criteria: Custom fields can be added to tasks, SOPs, clients, and vendor entities
Supported field types: text, number, date, single-select, multi-select, checkbox
Custom fields appear in search, filter, and export results
Entity templates pre-fill fields for quick creation of common items

features.name: Import/Export & Bulk Operations
features.description: Import existing data from CSV/Excel and export any data view. Bulk edit, assign, or archive multiple records at once.
acceptance_criteria: CSV import with column mapping, validation, and error reporting
All list views support CSV and Excel export
Bulk select supports mass-assign, mass-archive, and mass-update operations
Import history tracks past imports with undo capability

features.name: Advanced Search & Filtering
features.description: Global search across all entities with advanced filters, saved views, and quick-access recent items.
acceptance_criteria: Global search bar indexes SOPs, tasks, clients, knowledge base, and messages
Advanced filters support combining multiple conditions with AND/OR logic
Users can save filter combinations as named views for quick access
Search results show relevant context snippets and link directly to items

features.name: Document Management
features.description: Upload, organize, and share business documents (contracts, licenses, manuals) with folder structure, tagging, and access controls.
acceptance_criteria: Files can be uploaded with drag-and-drop, organized in folders, and tagged
Access permissions follow role-based rules
Documents can be linked to SOPs, vendors, clients, and tasks
Version history tracks document updates with previous versions accessible

features.name: Email & SMS Notifications
features.description: Configurable notification system delivering alerts via in-app, email, and SMS for task assignments, escalations, deadlines, and workflow events.
acceptance_criteria: Users can configure notification preferences per channel (in-app, email, SMS) and event type
Critical escalations always trigger all enabled channels
Notification digest option for batching non-urgent alerts
SMS notifications work for shift changes and urgent escalations

features.name: Webhook & API Access
features.description: RESTful API for programmatic access and outgoing webhooks to integrate with external tools like accounting software, POS systems, and CRMs.
acceptance_criteria: Documented REST API with authentication via API keys
Outgoing webhooks configurable per event type with retry logic
API rate limiting and usage tracking per API key
Webhook delivery logs with payload inspection and manual retry

features.name: Calendar Integration
features.description: Two-way sync with Google Calendar and Outlook for staff schedules, task deadlines, and client appointments.
acceptance_criteria: OAuth-based connection to Google Calendar and Microsoft Outlook
Shifts and task deadlines sync bidirectionally with external calendars
Calendar events created in OpsBase appear in connected calendars within 5 minutes
Conflict detection alerts when external calendar events overlap with shifts

features.name: Business Settings & Configuration
features.description: Company profile, business hours, locations, department structure, branding, and global preferences for the organization.
acceptance_criteria: Business profile captures name, industry, logo, business hours, and timezone
Multiple locations/departments can be configured with separate settings
Global defaults for notifications, escalation timeouts, and approval thresholds
Settings changes are logged in the audit trail

features.name: Billing & Subscription Management
features.description: Self-service plan management with usage-based billing, invoice history, and payment method management via Stripe integration.
acceptance_criteria: Users can view current plan, usage, and upgrade/downgrade options
Stripe integration handles payment processing and subscription lifecycle
Invoice history with downloadable PDF invoices
Grace period and dunning emails for failed payments

features.name: Team Member Management
features.description: Invite team members via email or link, manage profiles, set roles, track onboarding progress, and handle offboarding with access revocation.
acceptance_criteria: Admins can invite users via email with role pre-assignment
Team member profiles show role, department, contact info, and activity summary
Onboarding checklist tracks required SOPs and training completion per new hire
Offboarding revokes all access and reassigns open tasks

features.name: Guided Onboarding Wizard
features.description: Step-by-step setup flow for new businesses covering company profile, first SOP creation, team invites, and workflow configuration with contextual tips.
acceptance_criteria: New accounts are guided through a multi-step onboarding flow
Steps include: business profile, invite team, create first SOP, set up first workflow
Industry-specific templates are suggested based on business type selection
Onboarding progress is saved and can be resumed later

features.name: Mobile-Responsive Views
features.description: Fully responsive web interface optimized for phone and tablet use so field staff can access SOPs, complete tasks, and communicate from any device.
acceptance_criteria: All core features are usable on screens as small as 375px wide
Touch-optimized controls for task completion, SOP navigation, and messaging
Offline indicator with graceful degradation when connectivity is poor
Camera access for uploading photos directly to tasks or documents

features.name: Keyboard Shortcuts & Quick Actions
features.description: Power-user productivity features including keyboard shortcuts for navigation, quick-create modals, and a command palette for fast access to any feature.
acceptance_criteria: Command palette accessible via Cmd/Ctrl+K for searching and navigating to any entity
Keyboard shortcuts for common actions: new task, new SOP, search, navigate sections
Quick-create modal allows task/note creation without leaving current view
Shortcut reference sheet accessible via ? key

hero.headline: Your Business Should Run Without You
hero.subheadline: OpsBase systematizes your operations — SOPs, task delegation, decisions, and team coordination — so you can finally step away without everything falling apart.

problem.headline: You ARE the single point of failure
points: Your team can't make decisions without you because there are no documented rules or authority levels — every question routes to the owner.
Procedures live in your head, not in a system. When you're unavailable, staff guess, improvise, or just wait — costing you clients and revenue.
You've tried project management tools but they're designed for tech teams, not service businesses. You need operations management, not sprint planning.

solution.headline: Systematize everything so your business runs itself
solution.description: OpsBase combines SOP documentation, task delegation with escalation rules, decision authority frameworks, and team coordination into one platform built for service businesses. Document your processes, delegate decisions with guardrails, automate routine workflows, and get a full report of what happened while you were away.

faq.question: Is OpsBase free to try?
faq.answer: Yes. OpsBase offers a 14-day free trial with full access to all features. No credit card required. After the trial, plans start at $49/mo for up to 10 team members.

faq.question: How is OpsBase different from Monday.com or Notion?
faq.answer: Those are general-purpose tools you have to build from scratch. OpsBase is purpose-built for owner-operated businesses — it includes SOP templates for your industry, decision delegation with spending limits, an owner absence mode, and return reports. No spreadsheet-to-board customization needed.

faq.question: What industries does OpsBase work for?
faq.answer: OpsBase is built for service businesses with 5-50 team members: trades (HVAC, plumbing, electrical), medical/dental practices, salons and spas, agencies, repair shops, restaurants, cleaning companies, and more.

faq.question: How long does it take to set up?
faq.answer: Most businesses are up and running in under a day. Our guided onboarding wizard walks you through setup, and industry-specific templates give you a head start on SOPs and workflows.

faq.question: Can my field staff use it on their phones?
faq.answer: Absolutely. OpsBase is fully mobile-responsive. Your team can view SOPs, complete tasks, respond to clients, and check their schedule from any phone or tablet browser.

faq.question: What happens to my data if I cancel?
faq.answer: You can export all your data (SOPs, tasks, knowledge base, documents) as CSV and PDF files at any time. After cancellation, your data is retained for 30 days before deletion.
